name: Lambdas as braced-init-list elements indent under their signature
note: LOGS-5799 (Kamil): struct initialised with lambda members. clang-format already formats it the normal K&R way (lambda body indented under the signature). The only other layout clang-format can produce is Allman ('{' on its own line) via BraceWrapping.BeforeLambdaBody: true, which is global and regresses P6/P4. So the current form is already the normal one — this lock guards it. Anonymised. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
